name: ai-edit-studio
description: Local-first video editor for Codex: 57 editing tools (auto-edit, edit by text, captions, reframe, music, render QC, publish packs) plus workflow skills for shorts, clips from long videos, talking heads and game trailers. Footage never leaves the computer.

interface.shortDescription: Edit video locally: shorts, clips, captions, music, QC.
interface.longDescription: A local video editor Codex can drive: raw footage or a long video in, checked platform-ready renders out (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, YouTube, Steam). Every change is an undoable revision, every render is measured (loudness, peaks, black frames). Nothing is uploaded or posted.
defaultPrompt: Use the viral-short skill to make a TikTok from my clips with three hook variants.
Use the long-to-shorts skill to cut my podcast episode into five vertical clips.
Use the quality-gate skill to check my last render before I post it.
